safety.do1: Stay alert for sudden changes in stream water clarity (turbid water indicates upstream slope erosion).
safety.do2: Evacuate immediately if you hear rumbling noises, trees cracking, or see boulders rolling down slopes.
safety.dont1: Do NOT cross flooded bridges, culverts, or blocked hillside roadways until clearance is issued.
safety.dont2: Avoid staying in ground-floor rooms adjacent to steep hill cuttings during torrential downpours.

hero.description: Real-time landslide early warning system for East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya — leveraging geospatial data, weather intelligence and community participation for a safer tomorrow.

features.heading: Everything you need to understand and respond to landslide risk.
features.card1_desc: Monitor rainfall, terrain and geospatial data to identify landslide-prone areas in real time.
features.card2_desc: Receive timely alerts and safety information via SMS, mobile app and public channels.
features.card3_desc: Enable citizens and field officials to report landslides, road blockages and other hazards from the field.

how_it_works.kicker: FROM DATA TO A SAFER TOMORROW
how_it_works.heading: How It Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: Collect real-time data from weather stations, sensors and satellite sources.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Analyze data using AI/ML to detect landslide risk and generate early warnings.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Share alerts with district authorities, field teams and local communities for faster response.

live_risk.heading: Know the Risk Before It Happens
live_risk.description: Explore real-time risk zones, monitoring stations, road networks and vulnerable communities across East Khasi Hills.

mission.heading: Building a Safer, More Resilient Northeast
mission.paragraph: Landslides can develop rapidly, but better information can give communities valuable time to prepare. NER Landslide Alert brings spatial intelligence, environmental data, AI and community reporting together in one platform.
mission.quote: Technology and people together can build a safer Meghalaya.

cta.heading: Know the Risk. Act Before It Becomes a Disaster.
cta.subtitle: Stay informed, report hazards and help build safer communities across East Khasi Hills.

footer.tagline: Together for a Safer, Stronger Northeast.
